"Other" is an unfiltered bucket: no vertical rules, so the network
served a suggestive dating creative in the native banner.
The "Adult ads" toggle was already OFF — it governs the adult vertical
only, not dating. That is why the toggle did not prevent it.
Publisher API is GET-only → category, toggle and campaign filters
can only be changed in the dashboard. Banner withdrawn meanwhile.
Not banned: status Approved, both units Active. Rebuilding the site would not help —
a fresh domain lands in the same unfiltered bucket.
render · ads invariants · hubs · writer pruning · sources · config
CI sanity check: every page has an h1 + JSON-LD
404.html exempt by design (an error document has no content to describe)
rule: every behaviour change needs a test — this build runs unattended daily
rule: verify against the live site, not only against the tests
Adsterra API token — NOT a CI secret
never in the repository · never in config.json · never in chat
a leaked key can be revoked; a leaked seed phrase cannot
DATA SOURCES — verified live, with the dead ends recorded so nobody retries them
LIVE power.larc.nasa.gov POWER climatology · api.worldbank.org · date.nager.at · api.coingecko.com (365 d key-free cap)
DEAD zippopotam.us (retired) · restcountries v2 (retired) · Binance klines (HTTP 451)
every source caches its last good response, so an upstream outage degrades freshness but never blanks a page
WHAT IS ACTUALLY LEFT — ranked by impact on revenue
1 Change the Adsterra category away from "Other" in the dashboard — API cannot do it (GET-only).
2 Search Console → URL Inspection → Request Indexing on the 10 hub pages. Manual, highest impact.
3 Submit the sitemap in Bing Webmaster Tools — IndexNow already works, this is the faster door in.
4 Replace the CPA placeholder with a real offer so the top and mid slots stop earning nothing.
5 Traffic: a custom domain plus genuine inbound links. Nothing else reaches 50 000 views/day.
Automated and already running: daily rebuild · Cloudflare mirror · IndexNow · enrichment · daily revenue report.
Full detail, code map and configuration reference: HANDOVER.md in the repository root.
Adsterra impressions are 0 because the site has no visitors, not because of a fault in the ad code —
the popunder was observed loading, firing its impression pixel and posting its click-tracking pixel (HTTP 200).
